description: Syncs open incidents from ServiceNow to Jira.
_lifecycle_note: This integration is schedule-driven, not a long-running service.
It is started by a TrafficController process (registered in the manager
registry as 'example-sn-jira--tc') which fires on the cron schedule
Each run: fetches open incidents from ServiceNow, maps and pushes them
to Jira, writes a run summary to shared space, then exits cleanly.
The TrafficController checks whether a previous run is still alive before
starting a new one, preventing overlapping executions. If a run exceeds
max_ttl seconds (see registry.json), the TC will kill and restart it.
